image_urls.description: Minimalist professional desk setup representing productivity and dashboard control
Trading and project analytics desk with visual charts and metrics
Tablet showing data analytics on wooden office desk

features: Demo mode with selectable sample users (Super User, Board Master, Team Member)
Email/password authentication and registration with persistent session
Multi-board management with customizable workflow stages (Backlog -> To Do -> In Progress -> Review -> Done)
Advanced Task & Subtask CRUD with subtask checklist progress tracking
Interactive Kanban board with card drag/drop or stage selectors, filtering, and search
Member role and permissions administration (Super User, Board Master, Member)
Comprehensive Dashboard emphasizing board health and member workload balance
Task assignment, due date management, priority flagging, and attachments
Real-time comments with member @mentions and notification center with unread badges
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust React fullstack application utilizing the existing FastAPI backend or mock storage service with localStorage persistence for seamless demo testing.
Implement the full authentication flow including Demo Mode user switcher for Super User, Board Master, and Regular Member.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, dropdowns, inputs, tabs, modals) have test-ids and accessible ARIA attributes.
Use Tailwind CSS for styling with a sophisticated dark obsidian and indigo/emerald accent palette (#090A0F, #12141C, #6366F1).
Build Kanban board with draggable/movable cards across customizable stages and subtask management.
Build the dual-focus dashboard tracking board health (completion rates, bottleneck stages) and member workload (assigned active tasks, overdue items).
Include notification center with real-time in-app badge counter and simulation of email alerts.
universal_guidelines: Do not use transparent headers without blur or solid background.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit text color on hover and focus.
Use generous spacing and clear typographic hierarchy.
Include data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements.
